# MedLadder

> Medical entrance exam question bank for FMGE, NEET PG, INI-CET and NEET SS preparation.

## Main Pages
- [MedLadder Home](https://medladder.top/) — Medical MCQ question bank and study dashboard.
- [FMGE](https://medladder.top/fmge) — FMGE preparation resources and previous-year questions.
- [NEET PG](https://medladder.top/neet-pg) — NEET PG preparation resources and previous-year questions.
- [INI-CET](https://medladder.top/inicet) — INI-CET preparation resources and previous-year questions.
- [NEET SS](https://medladder.top/neet-ss) — NEET SS preparation resources and question bank.

## Discovery
- [Sitemap](https://medladder.top/sitemap.xml) — Full list of indexable MedLadder URLs.
- [Robots](https://medladder.top/robots.txt) — Crawl directives for search engines and agents.

## Content Guidance
MedLadder content is intended for medical examination preparation and educational practice. Question explanations should be interpreted in the context of exam preparation and not as a substitute for individualized clinical advice.
